Meteorology

Температурная инверсия

A meteorological condition where temperature increases with altitude instead of decreasing, which can trap pollutants and affect aircraft climb performance.

Quick answer: A meteorological condition where temperature increases with altitude instead of decreasing, which can trap pollutants and affect aircraft climb performance.

Definition

A meteorological condition where temperature increases with altitude instead of decreasing, which can trap pollutants and affect aircraft climb performance.

Operational example

Climb performance may be reduced due to a temperature inversion above two thousand feet.

Localized term

Температурная инверсия

Localized example

Характеристики набора высоты могут снизиться из-за температурной инверсии выше двух тысяч футов.
